body.statement: A finite family of real-analytic functions admits, locally, Weierstrass polynomial preparation and a compatible semianalytic stratification. A relatively compact semianalytic set consequently has finitely many connected components and a finite compatible stratification into connected real-analytic manifolds. Projections of relatively compact semianalytic sets are subanalytic, and the number of connected components of the fibers of a relatively compact subanalytic map is locally bounded. In dimension one, every punctured local semianalytic branch admits a real-analytic arc parametrization, with Puiseux preparation available as a proof mechanism. At a simple zero, the corresponding branch is an analytic graph by the analytic implicit-function theorem.
